basic_details.job_title: VNMKV Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in for 3 Field Assistant and Computer Operator Posts
basic_details.short_information: Vasant Rao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth (VNMKV), Parbhani will hold a walk-in interview on 6 November 2026 at 11.00 am in the chamber of the Officer Incharge, Agricultural Research Station, Badnapur, Dist. Jalna, with scrutiny and verification of original documents on the same day at 10.00 am. Three temporary contract posts are to be filled, 2 Field Assistant and 1 Computer Operator, each at Rs. 22,000/- per month (fixed), under the ICAR-sanctioned "National Mission on High Yielding Seeds Pigeonpea". The posts last up to 31 March 2027 or earlier, depending on the project budget.

content_sections.heading: About VNMKV Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Vasant Rao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth, Parbhani is an agricultural university, and this recruitment is for its Agricultural Research Station, Badnapur in Jalna district. The Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) has sanctioned the "National Mission on High Yielding Seeds Pigeonpea" for 2026-27, and the Badnapur station is one of the centres implementing it. According to the notice, the project aims to enhance hybrid performance through genetic profiling and heterotic pools, to map genomic loci restoring pollen fertility in A2 CMS to improve parental lines for tolerance to biotic and abiotic stresses, and to identify high yielding hybrids in pigeonpea in Maharashtra state.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The Field Assistant must hold a B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. Experienced candidates should be preferred. The notice does not state the length or type of experience. The Computer Operator must be a graduate in any degree and hold MS-CIT or DOEACC, along with typing in Marathi and English. Experienced candidates should be preferred. The age limit for both posts is not more than 45 years. Age relaxation is as per rule for SC/ST/NT/OBC categories. The notice does not print a date on which age is counted. Both posts carry Rs. 22,000/- per month, fixed. The posts are to be filled purely on a temporary basis up to 31 March 2027, or earlier as per the availability of budget in the project. The appointment will be on contract basis, and the incumbent shall not have any claim for regular appointment under VNMKV, Parbhani. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. When is the VNMKV ARS Badnapur walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 6 November 2026 at 11.00 am. Scrutiny and verification of original documents takes place on the same day at 10.00 am.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held in the chamber of the Officer Incharge, Agricultural Research Station, Badnapur, Dist. Jalna.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 2 Field Assistant and 1 Computer Operator.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for these posts?
faq.answer: Field Assistant requires B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. Computer Operator requires a graduate in any degree plus MS-CIT or DOEACC and typing in Marathi and English. Experienced candidates are preferred for both posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is not more than 45 years. Age relaxation is as per rule for SC/ST/NT/OBC categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Both Field Assistant and Computer Operator get Rs. 22,000/- per month, fixed.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring the required original documents and one set of attested Xerox copies.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on contract basis and purely temporary, up to 31 March 2027 or earlier depending on the project budget. The incumbent has no claim for regular appointment under VNMKV, Parbhani.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Which project are these posts under?
faq.answer: The posts are under the ICAR-sanctioned "National Mission on High Yielding Seeds Pigeonpea" for 2026-27, implemented at the Agricultural Research Station, Badnapur.
